2. Configure DSW1 as primary root for VLANs 10 and 20, and secondary root for VLANs 30 and 40.
3. Configure DSW2 as primary root for VLANs 30 and 40, and secondary root for VLANs 10 and 20.
4. Verify the root bridge for each VLAN.
5. Identify root, designated, and alternate ports and verify their states.
6. Test redundant uplink failover and observe reconvergence.
7. Enable PortFast and BPDU Guard on PC-facing ports.
